**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User's niece is named Emma.  
[FACT] Emma just graduated from high school.  
[TEMPORAL] Emma graduated yesterday, which was October 14, 2023.  
[EVENT] User is looking for gift ideas to commemorate Emma's graduation.  
[RELATIONSHIP] User is Emma's aunt/uncle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated Emma on her graduation and offered gift suggestions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested gift ideas include personalized items, memories and reflections, experiences and adventures, practical and functional gifts, inspirational and motivational gifts, and cash or gift cards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Specific personalized item suggestions include an engraved necklace or bracelet, customized photo album or frame, and a monogrammed tote bag.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested experiences include tickets to a concert, play, or sporting event, and planning a fun outing or weekend getaway.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested practical gifts include a new laptop or tablet, high-quality kitchen essentials, and a cozy care package.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested inspirational gifts include a motivational book, artwork with an inspiring quote, and a subscription to a magazine or online platform.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested online stores for customized jewelry include Etsy, Zales, Things Remembered, Personalization Mall, and Amazon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended checking return and refund policies, as well as production and shipping times when shopping online.  
[EVENT] User attended Emma's graduation ceremony on a sunny Saturday in late May.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant expressed joy about the emotional experience of attending the graduation ceremony and inquired if Emma gave a speech or received any awards.  
[EVENT] User mentioned that Emma received a few awards for her academic achievements during the graduation ceremony.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated Emma on her academic achievements and suggested that the personalized necklace would complement her awards nicely.  
[EVENT] User decided to write a heartfelt letter to Emma to express pride and hopes for her future.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for writing a heartfelt letter, including starting with a warm greeting, expressing pride, sharing personal memories, and offering words of wisdom.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested keeping the letter concise and adding a personal touch, such as a handwritten note or a favorite quote.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided closing sentence ideas to inspire Emma, including "Remember, your dreams are within reach, and I'll be cheering you on every step of the way."  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers to write a heartfelt letter rather than record a video message.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested ways to make the letter look special, including using high-quality paper,
